scope: width-1 storage for already-admitted byte lists; no source syntax or milestone claim

fir.write: low eight bits of type-1 word
fir.read: zero-extended unsigned byte in type-1 word

assembly.allowed_change_rule: frozen per source row from typed byte-list uses/declarations and explicit byte-list annotations
assembly.unchanged_rule: compare both source key sets and each assembly digest outside the allowed set; no borrowed numerical count

plant.break: return 8 instead of 1 for a bytes shape; all native byte-list creation/materialization uses this query

conditional_delta.condition: fresh successful execution on both engines, no old-row loss or unlisted gain; historical evidence unchanged

runtime.boundary: owned freestanding C -> assembly -> pinned clef -> pinned ligature and musl runtime; no system assembler/linker fallback
